text: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
author: Chinese proverb

text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
author: Will Durant

text: Take a breath, thank yourself for how far you have come, and get curious how far you can push it.
author: Raf

text: If you run, you constantly look forward - worrying about the future. It is only when you stop, you can take a look around and appreciate the present.
author: Nara

text: Never attribute to malice, what can be attributed to incompetence or tiredness.
author: Robert J. Hanlon

text: De todos modos, lo sabré pronto.
author: Duolingo

text: Success consists of going from failure to failure without loss of enthusiasm.
author: Winston Churchill

text: Perpetual optimism is a force multiplier.
author: Colin Powell

text: You have to be willing to be misunderstood if you're going to innovate. The hardest part isn't creating something new. It's staying committed while others don't see it yet.
author: Jeff Bezos
